title: Features: a switch didn't save
summary: DJDL's Features after turning Commerce on failed to save: the switch is back off, the row carries a danger edge, and its status column says Commerce didn't turn on, with Try again and a reference id; no toast and no Commerce group in the sidebar.
compare: A switch that fails to save returns to its old position at once; the error stays on that row (role=alert) and never as a toast, and doesn't auto-dismiss (EXPERIENCE.md §7, §9).

The status column says what didn't happen ('Commerce didn't turn on.'; the switch back at Off shows nothing changed), then Try again and the reference id; Try again repeats the same change. A refusal with a known cause says that cause and its fix instead ('Licensing was turned off at 14:02. Turn it on first.').
The sidebar is unchanged (no Commerce group), so the page and the chrome agree.
Phone: the error, Try again and the reference wrap under the requirements.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

findings.resolution: Red left border kept; the failure is a meta line under the row and the reference is a copy chip.

findings.issue: Add a cause clause ('Couldn't reach Polaris Key.') to the failure text.
findings.resolution: declined: The cause is not known in the mockup data; it would be invented copy.
